name: Intro rule
summary: An H-box state can be split into two copies, controlled by a bit and its negation.
description:
The left-hand side discards the input (with a phase-free Z-effect) and outputs an H-box state with label $a$. On the right-hand side the input is copied; one copy, negated, and the other copy each control an arity-2 H-box with label $a$. Since exactly one of $x$ and $\neg x$ is $1$, the output is always $|0\rangle + a|1\rangle$.

Read from right to left, the rule removes a pair of H-boxes with the same label that differ only by a NOT on one of their connections; it is a close cousin of the [generalised multiply rule](../zh-multiply-generalised/).
